reviews.decision_reason: select_demand preserves the supplied corpus identifiers and fields into the returned data path; the downstream loss of demand records is not localized here.

normalize truncates the selected demand records to a one-row bounded window, leaving only n06-r01 in the needs handoff. That drops records such as n06-r02 and n06-r03 whose needs match available downstream capabilities, causing the replay to treat the top need as unsupported and produce the wrong prioritization surface. This is behaviorally significant and localized to normalize.

assemble_provenance ranks and emits provenance for the normalized rows it receives with missing-safe field access and deterministic ordering. The incorrect one-record provenance is a consequence of the upstream normalized input, not this unit.
